report: Revision pairing theorem T3 (SPEC section 9, the Kohn-Sham level): completion checks, exact, WolframScript

checks.name: T3C_mean_field_coefficients_from_ks_theory
checks.detail: the Kohn-Sham potentials READ from ks-theory.json exchange.kohnShamPotentials: M_eff coefficient 15/16, v_v coefficient -1/16, e_int = (15/32) lambda S^2 - (1/32) lambda n^2 (verify_t3.wls writes these numbers into the script and its v_v clause compares vvf[lam, n] with itself; check_t3.py reads them). Consistency: M_eff - m = d e_int/dS and v_v = d e_int/dn. Map: M_eff[-m, +lambda, -S] = -M_eff[m, lambda, S], e_int even in S, v_v free of S; with (-m, -lambda) M_eff is not mapped to -M_eff (control)

checks.name: T3C_filling_convention_mapped
checks.detail: the filling CONVENTION of ks-theory.json thermodynamics (hypothesis H5: particles = the levels with eps > 0 of the lambda = 0 problem plus the k = 0 brane zero modes, each followed continuously in lambda) is carried onto the image problem: (i) for every coupling lambda' of the continuation and any S(y), sigma2 h_j(m + (15/16) lambda' S) = h_(-j)(-(m + (15/16) lambda' S)) sigma2 (both j), so the map sends the lambda = 0 levels with eps > 0 onto the image's lambda = 0 levels with eps > 0 (same eps) and commutes with the continuation in lambda; (ii) the k = 0 brane zero mode (E^(M y), 0) of (M, j, even, theta = 0) (h_j = 0, b(0) = 0, b(-L) = 0) goes to (0, I E^(M y)), a zero mode of h_(-j)(-M) with odd parity (a(0) = 0) and the transformed tip theta = Pi (a(-L) = 0), brane-localised like the original (|chi|^2 = E^(2 M y), M > 0), for both j; it violates the UNtransformed tip theta = 0 (control). Hence the occupied set of the image is the image of the occupied set, with the same occupations (equal levels, degeneracies and N)

checks.name: T3C_krein_rule_16_component
checks.detail: 16-component level with the expectation rule of the canonical quantisation (SPEC section 6, ks-theory.json exchange.expectationRule: <Psi^dag X Psi> = Tr(X rho), rho = sum f u u^dagger B) and gamma^(x1..x8), B, C, Gamma of gammas.json: Gamma^2 = 1, Gamma B Gamma = -B, Gamma C Gamma = C, Gamma gamma^a Gamma = -gamma^a (a = 1..8), Gamma S^ab Gamma = S^ab (all 64); for a general 16-vector u, (Gamma u)(Gamma u)^dagger B = -Gamma (u u^dagger B) Gamma, so the image state has rho' = -Gamma rho Gamma and <X>' = -Tr(Gamma X Gamma rho). Hence n = <B> is unchanged, S = <C> and Q = <B gamma^(x8)> change sign, and the kinetic bilinears Psibar gamma^a d Psi and Psibar gamma^a S^bc Psi (X = C gamma^a and C gamma^a S^bc, all 8 + 512; the spin connection Omega = (1/2) omega_ab S^ab commutes with Gamma) are unchanged; with m -> -m the mass term m S and U = (lambda/2) S^2 with the same lambda are unchanged: every component of the 16-component energy-momentum tensor (Belinfante form, SPEC section 4) and the current J^a = <C gamma^a> of the image state with (-m, +lambda) equal those of the original state (S6)
